### Donaldson to Webcast First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Conference Call


05 November 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/581939372/files/doc_news/Donaldson-to-Webcast-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI), a leading worldwide provider of innovative filtration products and solutions, will webcast its first quarter 2027 earnings conference call on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. CT.


**WEBCAST:**


To listen to a live webcast of the call, visit the “Events & Presentations” section of Donaldson’s Investor Relations website at[IR.Donaldson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.donaldson.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54635538&newsitemid=20261105271798&lan=en-US&anchor=IR.Donaldson.com&index=1&md5=fe780fe6d87906feef5940774ddf04b8) and click on the “listen to webcast” option.


**REPLAY:**


The webcast replay will be available within the “Events & Presentations” section of Donaldson’s Investor Relations website beginning at approximately 12:00 p.m. CT on Wednesday, December 2, 2026.


**About Donaldson Company, Inc.**


Founded in 1915, Donaldson (NYSE: DCI) is a global leader in technology-led filtration products and solutions, serving a broad range of industries and advanced markets. Diverse, skilled employees at over 150 locations on six continents partner with customers - from small business owners to R&D organizations and the world’s biggest OEM brands. Donaldson solves complex filtration challenges through three primary segments: Mobile Solutions, Industrial Solutions and Life Sciences. Additional information is available at[www.Donaldson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.Donaldson.com&esheet=54635538&newsitemid=20261105271798&lan=en-US&anchor=www.Donaldson.com&index=2&md5=669d745745284aacccaecde41cc23df0) .
